subject: [hw] start: read WORKER_RULES.md, then your package
body: Lead = hw-lead (Fable). Files: gpu/hwcodec/WORKER_RULES.md, PLAN.md, STATUS.md, work_packages.json, include/*.h (frozen: post defects to hw-lead with the proposed text). Disk: builds ONLY under /tmp/n2hw-<id>/ (<100 MB), sources only in the tree. No phone. First 30 min: hw-d01 posts the import lists per shim table; hw-v02 posts its routing table (mask/match -> class function); hw-v41 posts the n2vcu API it needs to hw-v40; hw-k02 posts kern/VCODEC_HW.md; hw-k01 and hw-k02 agree n2vc_ven_get/put. Known host limits: no qemu-arm, no capstone: oracles are llvm-mc/llvm-objdump, the ARM ARM, and the T01 differential harness. Post [hw] DONE <id> with the last line of run_tests.sh and the not-done list.
